promptText:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI auth state concept
Input image role: the visible source screenshot is a reference image for layout, state, and information architecture, not an edit target that must be pixel-preserved.
Primary request: Redesign 02-A-02-login/session-expired.
Direction: expired session banner above form.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 web app screenshot, no browser chrome and no OS window frame. Place a compact session-ended banner above the form, then keep returning learner welcome, email/password form, primary login CTA, password reset, sign-up path, and social login. The form remains the main task.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI mockup, Ant Design-friendly login page.
Color palette: #f4f4f5 canvas, #ffffff form card, #ececee banner/helper surface, #09090b primary button, #71717a helper text.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, compact density, weight-driven hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: do not invent account lockout, captcha, token, raw Supabase details, or scary security language; Korean UI text is placeholder visual guidance only.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS window frame, loud AI gradients, colorful CTAs, oversized bubble cards, provider raw errors, watermark.
negativeConstraints: no distorted Korean text as final copy
